notes: skate: support-boot sole tracked on the full boot layer; error = frame-to-frame sole shift minus the in-place slide (12,6)/frame (= 0 drift in game at 161 cell px/cycle)
bob: helm-top row of the rigid torso layer; game px = cell px x 0.30

axe_head_visibility: visible share of the axe sub-piece head (beyond 110 painted px from the grip); E far axe: unclipped head as denominator, visible px must lie inside the TA sides-pass magenta (dilated 4 px), share <= 0.25
W/N are exact horizontal mirrors of S/E (np.fliplr of the 512 cell, pivot x=256)
